summary: Iteration 15: Tested 3 new features: (1) Multibagger hover with tbody.multibagger-group CSS approach, (2) Custom stock search in Multibagger section, (3) F&O T1/T2/Best Exit expiry-aware projections with theta decay and date format. Found and fixed a critical backend bug where _position_to_response was missing best_exit_date_str and remaining_trading_days fields from the constructor call.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Missing best_exit_date_str and remaining_trading_days from CustomPositionResponse constructor call. They were defined in the Pydantic model but not passed, causing them to always return defaults (None and 0) regardless of what was stored in MongoDB.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added best_exit_date_str=position.get('best_exit_date_str') and remaining_trading_days=int(position.get('remaining_trading_days') or 0) to the constructor call.
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: Custom position cards were always showing 'T+N Trading Days @ ₹X' WITHOUT the date. After fix: 'T+2 Trading Days (24 Mar 2026) @ ₹7.85' is displayed correctly.

rca_of_issue: Bug: _position_to_response at line 4506 creates CustomPositionResponse with explicit field assignments. The fields best_exit_date_str and remaining_trading_days were added to the CustomPositionResponse Pydantic model but were NOT added to the constructor call. Since Pydantic uses defaults (None and 0) for missing optional fields, the API always returned these as None/0 regardless of what was computed and stored in MongoDB. Fix: Add the two missing field assignments to the _position_to_response constructor call.
